name: Instant Handyman
note_on_city: Google Maps ficha displays the business as Pompano Beach, FL (coords 26.2054655,-80.2157984). The Florida Division of Corporations (Sunbiz, via bisprofiles.com mirror) lists the registered LLC address as a UPS-Store-style suite in Oakland Park (3350 NE 12th Ave, #23213, Oakland Park, FL 33307), and Yelp/search-engine listings show a service address at 300 E Oakland Park Blvd, Ste 167, Wilton Manors, FL 33334. This is consistent with a home-based/mobile handyman operating across the Pompano Beach / Wilton Manors / Oakland Park metro area (no public storefront), matching the task brief's note. No single 'real' street address could be independently verified as a place customers visit, so no address/map section is used anywhere.
address_note: Not shown on the Google Maps ficha itself (no address field visible in the rendered listing, only pin coordinates). Third-party mirrors (Yelp, bisprofiles) show two different suite addresses (see note_on_city). Not used as a verified 'business address' anywhere in outreach material; omitted rather than guessed.
phone_source: Task brief (pre-verified live against Google Maps). Independently corroborated in this session via: Google Maps ficha itself (Playwright screenshot, phone shown directly under the rating: '+1 267-752-9639'), and via web search snippets of the Yelp listing (yelp.com/biz/instant-handyman-wilton-manors) and Thumbtack/HomeAdvisor aggregator snippets, all showing the identical number for the identical business name and near-identical address block. Confirms Yelp's 'Instant Handyman' in Wilton Manors and the Google Maps 'Instant handyman' in Pompano Beach are the SAME business (same phone number).
